system.description:
The manse's Essence powers strategic heavy weaponry. This provides (manse's rating x 2) Artifact dots to spend on weaponry permanently tied to the manse's geomancy and secured in its structure. Because these artifacts are simplified versions with an enormous Essence source, they subtract 2 from their Repair Value and ignore requirements involving hearthstones with a value equal to or less than the manse's rating.

No weapon's Artifact rating can exceed the manse's own rating, and they must be aimed and fired with Central Control (Power 2) unless the manse has a power such as Ability Enlightenment (Power 4) it can use to fire them itself.

See Wonders of the Lost Age for large-scale Essence weaponry. Non-integrated Essence artillery is an artifact, and should be bought as a separate Background.
